sections.subhead: Launch a Shopify Store Built to Convert, Not Just Go Live

body.text: Teknoppy builds Shopify stores in Kochi for brands selling in India and the UAE - custom theme design, product pages, apps and payment setup, launched in 3-5 weeks. Shopify handles hosting and security, so your team focuses on selling.

Shopify provides world-class cloud infrastructure, but stock templates and plugin bloat can hurt conversion rates and mobile load speeds. We architect custom Online Store 2.0 themes, integrate frictionless Indian UPI checkout flows, and configure multi-currency Shopify Markets for international reach.

items.title: Online Store 2.0 Custom Theme Architecture
items.html: Custom Liquid development using modular drag-and-drop sections, allowing your marketing team to build high-converting landing pages and promotional banners without touching code.

items.title: High-Converting Product Pages & Cart UX
items.html: Conversion-focused layouts featuring sticky checkout triggers, dynamic color and size swatches, custom bundle builders, and authentic customer review displays.

items.title: Indian & GCC Payment Gateway Integration
items.html: Seamless setup of Razorpay, Cashfree, and PayU with instant mobile UPI intent switching, alongside Stripe, PayPal, and Apple Pay for GCC and international customers. Explore Payment Gateway Integration.

items.title: App Stack Curation & Custom Private Apps
items.html: We install and configure only vetted, lightweight apps (Klaviyo, Loox, Shiprocket, WhatsApp automated recovery), and develop custom private apps when third-party tools fall short.

items.q: How much does a Shopify store cost in Kochi?
items.a: A professional Shopify store typically costs ₹45,000 to ₹85,000 for a curated starter store (3 weeks), and ₹90,000 to ₹1,80,000 for a fully bespoke custom-designed Liquid theme (4–5 weeks). Shopify platform hosting plans and paid app subscriptions are billed separately by Shopify.

items.q: Can a Shopify store accept UPI and handle Indian GST?
items.a: Yes. We integrate Indian payment gateways like Razorpay, Cashfree, or PayU to enable seamless UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm QR and intent), and configure GST-compliant tax calculations, HSN codes, and automated customer tax invoices.

items.q: Do I own my Shopify store?
items.a: You own 100% of your business data, product catalog, customer lists, and custom theme code. The underlying hosting and commerce software is licensed via Shopify on a predictable monthly subscription plan.

items.q: How is Shopify different from WooCommerce?
items.a: Shopify is a fully managed cloud platform where Shopify handles servers, security, and updates for a monthly fee. WooCommerce is open-source software running on WordPress that gives you full hosting control. Shopify is best for brands prioritizing speed of execution and low technical maintenance.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing store to Shopify?
items.a: Yes. Our Ecommerce Redesign & Migration services safely transfer product catalogs, customer records, and order history from WooCommerce, Magento, or OpenCart to Shopify, with comprehensive 301 URL redirect maps to preserve existing search rankings.

items.q: Will our Shopify store be optimized for search engines?
items.a: Yes. We implement structured collection URLs, optimized title and meta tags, fast WebP media, and JSON-LD product schema to maximize search visibility. For ongoing organic growth, explore our Ecommerce SEO Services.
